title: Coordinates for the rational purity exchange endpoints
statement: Define the pasted comparison using the ordinary functor associators. BaseConditions records Noetherianity, finite Krull dimension and invertibility of ell. LatticeDomain records the retained integral constructible representative with uniform Tor interval; PullbackLattice uses the actual integral pullback of that representative. Use LocalizedFamily from def-pur-rational-purity-localized-family-data. Define endpointA, endpointB, comparisonA, comparisonB, s, tGamma, shiftA and shiftB exactly as the original endpoint theorem. EndpointEquations retains both squares and all endpoint unit, tower and shift equations. These thirteen definitions retain their original names, types and bodies.
